stem.text: Light of a particular wavelength $\lambda_\text{s}$ is emitted from the Sun. At any instant, a band of wavelengths ranging from less than $\lambda_\text{s}$ to more than $\lambda_\text{s}$ is observed on the Earth. This is caused by the Doppler effect.

stem.alt: Circle labelled Sun with three arrows pointing right from it. To the right is a small circle symbol labelled Earth.

stem.text: What could be the explanation for this Doppler effect?

A.text: The Sun is moving at right-angles to a line joining the Sun and the Earth.

B.text: The Sun is moving away from the Earth.

C.text: The Sun is moving towards the Earth.
